use_when: The player directly changes nature, minds, rules, luck, terrain, or fate.

required_output.gm_summary: Power, cost, witness, and continuity consequence.

settlement_plan.map: Brush, weather, or piece movement if relevant.

constraints: Do not use cost as punishment by default; use causality.
If the player has absolute authority, record consequences rather than blocking the act.
If no durable consequence exists, keep it as support narration rather than canon settlement.
